words.meaning: Relating to dreams or dreaming; dreamlike.
words.sentence1: The quiet night had an oneiric quality beneath the glowing firmament. (The quiet night had an oneiric quality beneath the glowing firmament.)
words.sentence2: Her stories blur the line between waking reality and an oneiric world of wonder. (Her stories blur the line between waking reality and an oneiric world of wonder.)

words.meaning: A bright star, especially the morning or evening star (Venus); a beacon of celestial light.
words.sentence1: El lucero del alba brillaba intensamente antes de que saliera el sol. (The morning star shone brightly before the sun rose.)
words.sentence2: Mirando al cielo despejado, un tenue lucero inspiro sus mas bellos suenos. (Looking at the clear sky, a faint bright star inspired her most beautiful dreams.)

words.meaning: A state of being pleasantly lost in one's thoughts; a daydream or fanciful contemplation.
words.sentence1: Elle contemplait la voute etoilee, perdue dans une douce reverie. (She gazed at the starry canopy, lost in a gentle reverie.)
words.sentence2: Le silence de la nuit nocturne plongea le poete dans une profonde reverie. (The silence of the nocturnal night plunged the poet into a profound daydream.)

words.meaning: A shooting star or meteor, traditionally believed to grant wishes to those who dream upon it.
words.sentence1: Als er eine helle Sternschnuppe sah, schloss er die Augen und wuenschte sich etwas. (When he saw a bright shooting star, he closed his eyes and made a wish.)
words.sentence2: In der klaren Sommernacht zog eine zarte Sternschnuppe ueber den dunklen Himmel. (On the clear summer night, a delicate shooting star streaked across the dark sky.)

words.meaning: Stardust; clusters of countless tiny stars illuminating the night sky.
words.sentence1: Yozora ni chirabatta hoshikuzu ga gin'iro ni kagayaite imasu. (The stardust scattered across the night sky is shining in silver.)
words.sentence2: Kanojo wa hoshikuzu o atsumeta you na utsukushii yume o mita. (She had a beautiful dream as if she had gathered stardust.)

words.meaning: Dreamlike; suggestive of or relating to dreams and imagination.
words.sentence1: La melodia sussurrata creava un'atmosfera onirica sotto la luce delle stelle. (The whispered melody created a dreamlike atmosphere under the starlight.)
words.sentence2: Il quadro mostrava un paesaggio onirico avvolto nel chiarore notturno. (The painting showed a dreamlike landscape enveloped in nocturnal glow.)

words.meaning: Dreamland or dreamscape; an ethereal realm of dreams and imagery.
words.sentence1: Shenye li, ta fangfu jinru le yige man shi xingguang de mengjing. (In the dead of night, she seemed to enter a dreamland filled with starlight.)
words.sentence2: Zhe pian shanhai de meijing furen ru tong zhishen mengjing. (The beauty of these mountains and seas makes one feel as if they are in a dreamscape.)

words.meaning: The Milky Way galaxy; the luminous river of stars across the heavens.
words.sentence1: Kkaman bamhaneure pyeolchyeojin eunhasuneun kkumcheoreom areumdawotta. (The Milky Way spread across the black night sky was dreamily beautiful.)
words.sentence2: Sonyeoneun eunhasureul barabomyeo sojunghan kkumeul kiwotda. (Looking at the Milky Way, the boy nurtured a precious dream.)

words.meaning: A dream, reverie, or vision experienced during slumber.
words.sentence1: Neang ban kheunh roeng la-or knong sobin robos neang kroum pkay rousneang. (She saw wonderful things in her dream beneath the twinkling stars.)
words.sentence2: Sobin la-or niw pel reatrey thveu oy chet sabay rik-reay. (Good dreams during the night bring peaceful joy to the spirit.)

words.meaning: A daydream, reverie, or visionary contemplation of one's aspirations.
words.sentence1: Hy het in 'n rustige dagdroom verval terwyl hy na die eerste aandster kyk. (He drifted into a peaceful daydream while watching the first evening star.)
words.sentence2: Haar dagdroom oor 'n reis na verre planete het haar verbeelding geprikkel. (Her daydream about a journey to distant planets sparked her imagination.)
